plausibledeniability.help: Under certain circumstances, you might be forced to disclose a password. To keep your coins safe, Cypher Box can create another encrypted storage with a different password. Under pressure, you may disclose this password to a third party. If entered in Cypher Box, it will unlock a decoy storage. This will seem legit to the third party, but it will secretly keep your main storage with coins safe.
plausibledeniability.help2: The decoy storage will be fully functional and you can store small amounts there so it looks believable. Note: this only masks your Hot and Cold Vaults. Your Lightning accounts (Strike, CoinOS) will remain visible in both interfaces since they are custodial accounts tied to your login.

capsules_info.title: About your lightning capsules
capsules_info.why_body_1: Your Bark balance is held as a collection of small lightning capsules (VTXOs). Each capsule has an expiry date. To keep your funds fully self-custodial, meaning you can always recover them yourself without needing the Second.tech server's permission, each capsule must be refreshed before it expires.
capsules_info.why_body_2: If a capsule expires without being refreshed, the Second.tech server can sweep the funds at any time. Recovery after expiry is not guaranteed, so treat the expiry date as a hard deadline.
capsules_info.why_body_3: Keeping capsules refreshed also pays off if you ever run an Emergency Exit: fresh capsules make the exit cheaper in fees, faster to settle, and more private.
capsules_info.reminders_title: How reminders keep your capsules safe
capsules_info.reminders_body_1: Cypher Box sends up to 6 reminder notifications before any lightning capsule expires. The schedule is fixed: 7 days, 4 days, 2 days, 24 hours, 12 hours, and 6 hours before expiry. Each one escalates in urgency. The two earliest exist so you still have time to exit on chain if you need to, which takes longer than a refresh.
capsules_info.reminders_body_2: Tap any reminder and Cypher Box opens directly on the Capsules tab, works out which capsules need refreshing, and shows you the fee before anything is spent. You do not need to find a button or pick capsules yourself. Tap Refresh on that summary to go ahead, or Cancel to leave the capsules as they are.
capsules_info.reminders_body_3: The Reminders toggle lives in two places: at the bottom of the Bark Vault Created screen when you first create your wallet, and on the Vault tab inside the Bark vault menu. Default is on. If you turn it off, no reminders fire and you alone are responsible for opening the app and refreshing your capsules before they expire.
capsules_info.reminders_body_4: The reminders are your safety net. Refreshing only works while the app is open, so tapping a reminder is what keeps your capsules alive.
capsules_info.spendable_title: Your balance stays spendable while it refreshes
capsules_info.spendable_body_1: Refreshing no longer locks your funds. When a capsule is refreshing, including the automatic step right after you receive over Lightning, you can keep spending it the whole time. There is no waiting for the refresh to finish before your balance is usable.
capsules_info.spendable_body_2: A refresh usually finishes within about an hour and gives the capsule a fresh full life. Just leave the app running until it completes.
capsules_info.color_yellow_body: Past the midpoint. Worth refreshing next time you're in the app.
capsules_info.color_orange_body: Within the refresh window. Refresh it now, before the reminders start.
capsules_info.color_red_body: Needs refresh now. Reminders are firing, tap one to refresh. After it expires, the server can claim the capsule.
capsules_info.status_backed_up_body: Spendable, and fully under your control. You can always recover it on-chain yourself. This is the everyday state.
capsules_info.status_refreshing_body: Being given a fresh full life. It stays spendable the whole time, usually under an hour, so you can keep using it while it refreshes.
capsules_info.status_in_flight_body: Being used in another operation: an outgoing send, withdrawal, or boarding. Briefly locked until that operation completes.
capsules_info.dust_body_1: A capsule at or below 500 sats is too small to refresh on its own, so the network will not let it renew alone. To keep dust alive, tap Dust refresh on the capsule: it batches several tiny capsules together, so their combined size clears the minimum, and consolidates them into one healthy capsule.
capsules_info.dust_body_2: Because the amounts are tiny, the fee for a dust batch can sometimes be close to or more than the dust itself, so it is a judgment call. If it is not worth it, just spend the dust as part of a normal payment before it expires. Receiving at least about 700 sats at a time avoids dust in the first place.
capsules_info.fees_body_1: These are the fees the Bark server charges. The refresh fee depends on how much time is left before a capsule expires, not on how old the capsule is. The closer to expiry, the cheaper the refresh.
capsules_info.fees_body_2: Second.tech sets these fees, not Cypher Box, and can change them at any time. The figures below were checked in September 2026. For the current schedule, see:
capsules_info.fee_receive_ln_body: 0%, free. The capsule you receive still has to be refreshed to extend its life by about 28 days, and that costs the refresh fee below.
capsules_info.fee_refresh_body: Free with under 2 days left, 0.2% from 2 to 7 days, 0.4% from 7 to 14 days, and 0.5% with more than 14 days left. A fresh capsule lasts about 28 days, so refreshing one that still has most of its life left costs the most. Waiting for a reminder is cheaper than refreshing on sight.
capsules_info.fee_send_ln_body: 0.2% to 0.5% of the amount, with a 20-sat minimum.
capsules_info.fee_withdraw_body: 0.2% to 0.5% of the amount, plus standard Bitcoin network fees for the on-chain transaction.
capsules_info.tip_body_1: Refreshing late is cheaper. Refreshing early leaves you more room to get out on your own. That is the whole trade.
capsules_info.tip_body_2: If the Second.tech server ever becomes unreachable, you can still recover your sats yourself with an Emergency Exit, straight to the blockchain, without the server's permission. That exit has to be started before the capsule expires, and it needs at least a day to complete.
capsules_info.tip_body_3: So refreshing in the free window, the last 2 days, costs nothing but leaves very little room if the server goes down right then. Refreshing with 2 to 7 days left costs 0.2% and keeps several days of exit room in hand. Refreshing earlier than that costs 0.4% to 0.5% for time the capsule already had.
capsules_info.tip_body_4: The middle is usually the right call, and it is where the reminders start.
capsules_info.tip_body_5: Cypher Box does this part for you. Whenever the app is open it refreshes any capsule with between 28 hours and one week of life left, which is the free and 0.2% part of that table. It never pays the 0.4% or 0.5% bands on your behalf.
capsules_info.tip_body_6: It stops at 28 hours on purpose. Any closer to expiry and a refresh that stalls could eat the day you would need to exit on your own, so the wallet leaves the capsule alone and warns you instead. Capsules under 500 sats are too small to refresh this way and are handled separately.
capsules_info.example_intro: Alex adds 100K sats at the end of every week for 10 weeks, then withdraws the full 1 million sats to cold storage. Using the fees above:
capsules_info.example_receive_body: Free over Lightning or on-chain. An on-chain deposit still pays the normal Bitcoin network fee to arrive.
capsules_info.example_deposit_title: Making each deposit last: about 2,000 sats
capsules_info.example_deposit_body: A Lightning deposit arrives as a short-lived capsule, good for only a few days. The wallet refreshes it straight away to buy the full 28 days. Because the fee tracks the time left on a capsule, that first refresh is a cheap one: free if the capsule arrives with under 2 days on it, otherwise 0.2%, about 200 sats per 100K deposit. Ten deposits, about 2,000 sats. Refreshing a second time right after pays the 0.5% band, because by then the capsule has its full 28 days again.
capsules_info.example_keep_alive_body: After that, a capsule only needs refreshing once every 24 days, and refreshing at the reminder costs 0.2%, or 200 sats per 100K. Across the 10 weeks that is 7 more refreshes.
capsules_info.example_withdraw_body: 0.2% to 0.5% of the 1M sats, depending on how much life the capsules have left, plus a few hundred sats of Bitcoin network fee.
capsules_info.example_total_body: About 0.55% to 0.85% of the 1M sats UTXO going to cold storage.
capsules_info.example_outro: That first refresh on each deposit is automatic and unavoidable, otherwise the capsule expires within days. The later ones are where Alex has a choice, and two habits keep him at the low end: let the reminder tell him when to refresh instead of refreshing on sight, and time the withdrawal for when his capsules are in their last week rather than just after a refresh. Both still leave him several days to exit on his own if the Second.tech server goes down.

checking_login.title: Add a Lightning Wallet
checking_login.intro: Pick a provider to power Lightning send/receive. Custodial accounts hold your bitcoin with a third party, while non-custodial wallets let you have full control over your keys and funds.
checking_login.non_custodial_subtitle: Create a self-custodial wallet. Keys under your full control.
checking_login.experimental_warning: Experimental technology. Use at your own risk.
checking_login.custodial_subtitle: Sign in to an existing Lightning account. Or create an account on provider's website and come back again to Cypher Box and login!
checking_login.strike_region_notice: Strike is not available in Cypher Box in your region. If Strike serves your country, you can use the Strike app directly, and pay to or from Cypher Box with a Lightning invoice or a bitcoin address.
checking_login.coinos_region_notice: CoinOS is not available in your region. You can use it directly at coinos.io, and pay to or from Cypher Box with a Lightning invoice or a bitcoin address.

checking_intro.title: Lightning Account
checking_intro.body: To use Bitcoin efficiently, you can create a Lightning Account at a reliable custodian. This entity will help you send and receive payments globally, instantaneously, with ~zero fees. You can also use it to accumulate a measured amount of bitcoin until you are able to economically withdraw to self-custody.
checking_intro.caution: Be careful: while bitcoin custodians and exchanges offer user friendly financial services, it's wise to exercise caution with the amount of money you entrust to them. As your balance increases, Cypher Box will notify you and provide instructions on how to secure your wealth independently, without the reliance on any third party custodian.

checking_account.withdraw_min_toast: Withdraw Threshold cannot be less than 2M
checking_account.withdraw_max_toast: Withdraw Threshold cannot be greater than 9M
checking_account.reserve_min_toast: Reserve Amount cannot be less than 100K
checking_account.reserve_max_toast: Reserve Amount cannot be greater than 2M
checking_account.threshold_desc: You can adjust the threshold at which a message will be displayed to remind you to withdraw and materialize the money accumulated on your Lightning Account and move it into self-custody.
checking_account.threshold_fees_note: Be aware that adjusting this threshold involves balancing Bitcoin network fees against counter-party risk.

checking_created.reminders_alert_title: Enable bark notifications to get VTXO capsule refresh reminders?
checking_created.reminders_alert_body: Cypher Box sends 6 reminders before any capsule expires (7 days, 4 days, 2 days, 24 hours, 12 hours, and 6 hours before). Tap a reminder to open Cypher Box, see what the refresh costs, and confirm it. Without a refresh, recovery is not guaranteed once a capsule expires.
checking_created.capsules_refresh_desc: To keep your balance available and self-custodial, your lightning capsules (VTXOs) need to be refreshed.
checking_created.reminders_on: Recommended. Cypher Box sends 6 reminders before any capsule expires (7 days, 4 days, 2 days, 24 hours, 12 hours, and 6 hours before). Tap a reminder to open Cypher Box, see what the refresh costs, and confirm it. Without a refresh, recovery is not guaranteed once a capsule expires.
checking_created.reminders_off: ⚠ Reminders are OFF. You must open Cypher Box yourself and refresh capsules before they expire. Once a capsule expires, recovery is not guaranteed.
checking_created.seed_bullet: • Your 12-word seed phrase. Write it down somewhere only you can access.
checking_created.bar_desc: The interactive bar display helps you visualize your Lightning Account's balance, showing a threshold above which storing bitcoin in an exchange carries increased counter-party risk. This threshold will also determine the size of the withdrawn UTXO coin.
checking_created.deposit_note: Note: You can deposit money beyond the threshold. It will just give you a reminder message if your balance reaches it. It won't withdraw automatically.

account_status.desc_1: Your Lightning Account has been created. The interactive bar display helps you in visualizing your Lightning Account's balance, indicating a threshold above which storing bitcoin in a bank carries increased counter-party risk.
account_status.desc_2: You can deposit money beyond the threshold, but remember, you are technically not the owner of it; you are relying on a third-party custodian. Cypher Box will enable you to become the sole owner of your money once you max out the bar slot (set to 2.1 million sats by default but you can adjust it in the settings).

change_username.verify_email_toast: ⚠️ Please verify your email now because the verification link will expire soon!
change_username.recovery_email_desc: For password resets and payment notifications only.

check_account.desc: To use Bitcoin efficiently, you can create a Lightning Account at a reliable bitcoin bank. This entity will help you send and receive payments globally, instantaneously, with ~zero fees. You can also use it to accumulate a measured amount of bitcoin, say 2M sats or $1500.
check_account.caution: while bitcoin banks and custodians offer user friendly financial services, it's wise to exercise caution with the amount of money you entrust to them. As your balance increases, exploring safer storage methods becomes crucial. Cypher Box will notify you and provide guidance on securing your wealth independently, without the reliance on any third party custodian.

create_ark.err_open_failed: Wallet state and seed don't match. Tap Reset to start over.
create_ark.reset_title: Reset Ark wallet on this device?
create_ark.reset_body:
This deletes the wallet's local state AND removes the seed phrase from your Keychain.

Without your written-down seed phrase AND your encrypted .cbark backup file, any funds in this wallet become permanently unrecoverable.

Only continue if:
• You don't own this wallet (e.g. previous device owner), OR
• You've written down your seed AND saved your backup file elsewhere
create_ark.last_chance_body: Tap 'Reset & wipe' to permanently delete the Ark wallet state on this device. This cannot be undone from inside the app.
create_ark.exists_body_1: An Ark wallet was found on this device. Open it to resume using the seed in your Keychain.
create_ark.exists_body_2: If this wallet isn't yours, or the seed no longer matches, tap Reset to delete everything and start over.
create_ark.experimental_body: Ark is a new Bitcoin Layer 2 protocol (by Second.tech). It enables cheap non-custodial Lightning-style payments. The SDK is still pre-1.0, so treat it as experimental.
create_ark.recovery_body: Recovery always needs your seed phrase. Your backup file (.cbark) is encrypted with that seed, so it can never restore anything on its own, and it brings back capsule state the server scan can miss. Keep both, and never lose the seed.
create_ark.derive_from_hot: Derive Ark wallet from your existing hot vault mnemonic.
create_ark.no_hot_vault: No hot vault found. A fresh seed will be generated.
create_ark.shared_seed_warning: 🔒 Ark will share the same seed as your Hot Vault. A leak of the mnemonic compromises both.
create_ark.fresh_seed_info: 🔑 A fresh Ark-only seed will be generated and stored securely.
create_ark.bullet_operator: • Single server operator (Second.tech) sees your payment activity.
create_ark.bullet_balance: • Balance state is on-device. Back up your app before wiping.
create_ark.bullet_receive: • Can receive Lightning payments and on-chain deposits (board).
create_ark.bullet_terms: • You also become a Second.tech user under their own terms:

ark_seed.no_seed: No seed phrase available. Go back and try again.
ark_seed.stale_title: Couldn't create wallet on top of old state
ark_seed.stale_body:
Leftover data from a previous Ark wallet is on this device. The new seed phrase you're about to back up can't replace it without wiping the old state first.

If you don't have access to the previous wallet's seed AND its backup file, those funds (if any) are not recoverable from this device anyway. Reset to continue.
ark_seed.still_failed: Wallet still couldn't be created after reset: {error}. Try force-quitting and reopening the app.
ark_seed.drive_connect_failed: Couldn't connect Google Drive. Make sure Play Services is up to date and try again.
ark_seed.icloud_on: iCloud Drive is on for Cypher Box. Backup syncs automatically.
ark_seed.prepare_failed: Couldn't prepare the backup file: {error}. Free up storage and try again.
ark_seed.saved_q_title: Did you save the backup file?
ark_seed.saved_q_body:
The .cbark file is encrypted with your seed phrase, safe to keep in iCloud Drive, email to yourself, or any cloud storage. Without this file plus your seed, your Bark balance can't be fully recovered.

The best path is to enable iCloud Drive for Cypher Box (iOS Settings → [your name] → iCloud → iCloud Drive → Cypher Box). Cypher Box will then keep an encrypted copy current in your iCloud Drive automatically. Until you do that, re-export from the reminder banner in Bark Settings → Bark Backup after every Lightning receive.
ark_seed.drive_verified: Backup uploaded to Google Drive and verified. It will keep updating automatically.
ark_seed.drive_verify_failed: Google Drive accepted the upload, but reading it back didn't return a valid backup. Save the backup file manually below to be safe.
ark_seed.backup_failed: Backup failed: {error}. Try again, or save the backup file manually below.
ark_seed.seed_not_saved_body: Your seed was not saved behind a fingerprint, because this device has no strong biometric set up right now. Nothing was stored, so write your 12 words down and keep them safe.
ark_seed.no_folder_picked: No folder picked. Tap "Pick folder" to try again.
ark_seed.folder_verified: Backup saved to your folder and verified. It will keep updating automatically.
ark_seed.folder_verify_failed: The backup was written to your folder but reading it back didn't return a valid file. Try picking a different folder.
ark_seed.folder_save_failed: Couldn't save the backup to that folder: {error}.
ark_seed.reveal_and_backup: Please reveal and back up your seed phrase first
ark_seed.save_backup_first_ios: Your seed phrase can restore the wallet on its own, but the backup file brings back capsule state the server scan can miss. Tap 'Save backup file' above and save it somewhere you trust (iCloud Drive recommended).
ark_seed.save_backup_first_android: Your seed phrase can restore the wallet on its own, but the backup file brings back capsule state the server scan can miss. Pick at least one: Google Drive (off-device), or a folder on this phone (survives uninstall).
ark_seed.keychain_save_failed: Keychain save failed. Please back up manually
ark_seed.keep_offline: Keep it safe and secure offline (paper and pen are good enough).
ark_seed.keychain_failed_manual: ✗ Keychain save failed. Please back up the words manually
ark_seed.header_note: These 12 words are what recover this wallet, on this device or a new one. Your {backup_file} is the safety net for capsules the server scan can miss. Set its destination below.
ark_seed.tap_to_reveal: Tap to reveal your seed phrase
ark_seed.backup_section_desc: Can be stored and auto-updated on this device and on your cloud. Each time you send or receive, an encrypted snapshot updates in {location}. That covers app reinstalls and data corruption.
ark_seed.ios_location: Files → On My iPhone → Cypher Box
ark_seed.lose_phone: Lose the phone, though, and the local file goes with it. Your seed can still restore the wallet, but an off-device copy brings back capsule state the server scan can miss:
ark_seed.android_option_label: Optional: sync backup to Google Drive
ark_seed.ios_option_detail: Opens the share sheet so you can save the encrypted ark-backup file. We recommend saving inside iCloud Drive, so Cypher Box keeps it current automatically as your VTXO capsules change. Anywhere else (email, AirDrop, local Files) works for recovery too, but you'll need to re-export after every Lightning receive. Whoever stores it sees ciphertext only.
ark_seed.android_option_detail: Connects your Google account and uploads your ark-backup file to Drive's appDataFolder, hidden from the main Drive UI, only Cypher Box can read it. Updates upload automatically as your VTXO capsules change. Google sees only ciphertext.
ark_seed.folder_option_label: Save to a folder on this phone (auto-updates)
ark_seed.folder_option_detail: Pick a folder you control, for example Internal Storage → Documents → Backups. The encrypted file is written there whenever your wallet changes, and unlike the app's private storage it {survives}. Whatever stores it sees ciphertext only.
ark_seed.save_before_body: Your seed phrase restores the wallet, and the server returns the capsules it still tracks for it. That scan is not guaranteed to find everything, and the backup file is what covers the rest. Pick any one option above before creating the wallet.

recover_ark.tap_unlock_first: Tap "Unlock with {biometric}" first, or type all 12 words manually.
recover_ark.type_all_first: Type all 12 seed words first, then choose your backup file.
recover_ark.validate_failed: Couldn't validate seed phrase. Check the words and try again.
recover_ark.invalid_seed: Invalid seed phrase. Double-check spelling. Each word must be a BIP39 word.
recover_ark.keychain_no_seed: Keychain returned no seed. Tap "Type seed manually" below.
recover_ark.biometric_declined: {biometric} was declined. Tap unlock again, or type your 12 words manually.
recover_ark.replace_existing_body: Restoring {source} replaces the current Ark wallet with the backup file. Any incoming Lightning payments still being settled won't carry over.
recover_ark.seed_not_saved_body: This device has no fingerprint set up, so the seed was not stored behind one and nothing was saved. Keep your 12 words safe, you will need them next time.
recover_ark.server_unreachable_intact: Your backup file is intact, but the wallet couldn't reach the Ark server right now. This is usually temporary. Check your internet connection and try again in a moment. Your funds and seed are safe; no need to pick a different backup file.
recover_ark.backup_corrupt: Backup file is corrupt: {error}. Try a different backup source: Drive, iCloud, or pick a manually-exported file.
recover_ark.no_match_type: No backup matches this seed phrase. Check the seed, or tap "{cta}" below if you don't have one.
recover_ark.no_match_choose: No backup matches this seed phrase. Check that you picked the right file, or try your other backup source.
recover_ark.picked_no_path: Couldn't read picked file (no path returned)
recover_ark.not_backup_for_seed: This file isn't a backup for the seed phrase you entered. Pick a different file, or check your seed.
recover_ark.drive_no_match: No backup matches this seed phrase in Google Drive. Check that you're signed in with the right Google account, or pick a backup file manually.
recover_ark.drive_no_match_seed_only: If you don't have one, tap "{cta}" below.
recover_ark.drive_unreachable: Couldn't reach Google Drive: {error}. Try again, or pick a backup file manually.
recover_ark.icloud_read_failed: Couldn't read backup from iCloud Drive: {error}. Make sure iCloud Drive is enabled for Cypher Box, then tap again. The picker should show "iCloud Drive → Cypher Box → ark-backup-{fingerprint}.cbark".
recover_ark.no_report_body: Your wallet is back, but the capsule scan didn't report a result, so this isn't proof that nothing is missing. Keep your 12 words safe and don't reset this wallet. If you have an ark-backup file, restoring from it is the way to be sure.
recover_ark.unresolved_none: The Ark server listed capsules for this seed, but none of them could be resolved.
recover_ark.unresolved_some_one: Brought back {count} capsule worth {sats} sats, but the scan couldn't account for everything.
recover_ark.unresolved_some_other: Brought back {count} capsules worth {sats} sats, but the scan couldn't account for everything.
recover_ark.unresolved_tail: Some funds may still be missing. Keep your 12 words safe and don't reset this wallet. If you have an ark-backup file, restore from it as well.
recover_ark.no_capsules_body: The Ark server had no capsules linked to this seed. Your wallet is open and usable. If you expected a balance, check that you typed the right seed phrase.
recover_ark.nothing_left_title: Wallet recovered, nothing left to restore
recover_ark.nothing_left_body: The Ark server's capsules for this seed were already spent or exited on-chain, so there was nothing to bring back. Your wallet is open and usable.
recover_ark.already_open_title: An Ark wallet is already open
recover_ark.already_open_body: There's a live Ark wallet on this device. Open the setup screen and reset it there first, then recover from your seed. Nothing has been changed.
recover_ark.reopened_body: This device already had this wallet's data, so it was reopened as it was. Nothing was deleted and nothing was re-downloaded.
recover_ark.server_unreachable_check: Couldn't reach the Ark server to check the wallet data already on this device, so nothing was changed. Check your connection and try again in a moment.
recover_ark.different_data_title: Different wallet data on this device
recover_ark.different_data_body: The Ark data on this device belongs to a different seed phrase, so it can't be reopened with the words you typed. Recovering replaces it. If that other wallet still holds funds, make sure its seed phrase is written down before you continue.
recover_ark.clear_failed: Couldn't clear the other wallet's data on this device. Open the setup screen and tap Reset, then try again.
recover_ark.open_create_failed: Couldn't open or create the Ark wallet. Local state may be stale. Open the setup screen and tap Reset, then try again.
recover_ark.seed_not_saved_continue: This device has no fingerprint set up, so the seed was not stored behind one. Recovery continues. Keep your 12 words safe, you will need them next time.
recover_ark.seed_not_saved_reason: The seed couldn't be saved to this device ({reason}). Your wallet is recovered and usable. Keep your 12 words safe, you will need them next time.
recover_ark.choose_body:
Your Ark seed phrase is in this device's Keychain, so you don't need to type it. Tap unlock below to load the seed via {biometric} / passcode.

Restoring from your ark-backup file, from {cloud} (if you connected it earlier) or a manual export, is the most complete option.
recover_ark.type_body_1: Enter the words exactly as you wrote them down. Order matters. Tap space or return to jump to the next box.
recover_ark.type_body_2: Your ark-backup file restores the most, so use the buttons below if you have one. Without it you can continue with the seed alone. Cypher Box checks the Ark server for capsules linked to your seed and brings back what it finds: all of them, some, or none.
